fallback_ratio.rule: P-S8-22 / U-S8-61 (s6_control_spec 302.4, 304 (1)): L1 plant_meta, L2b / SCM column_nominal

valve.integration: exact exponential per step, leg speed = step mean (s6 spec 148 R-2)
valve.acts_on: speed reference u (valve flow / A_p) -> s_ref and the dashpot term

saturation_steps.rule: static end - limit <= 0.25 kN = law-C mechanism share (dyn 5.24.2); static window ASSUMPTION; t relative to the start state

crawler_contact_model.check_note: S8-L4 failed 2026-10-24: NSC compliance creeps (no restoring spring) in pychrono 10.0.0; crawler contact stays rigid NSC, S8-L5 tag applies

s8.source: L2bModel.crawler_contact['model'] (rigid / compliant, U-S8-L3) and crawler_check_passed (S8-L4) or CRAWLER_CHECK_PASSED; absent = nsc_rigid

flow_limit.basis: hydraulic_coupling_criteria.md 9, 9.1; per physics step after the valve, before stroke-end braking and law C

valve.integration: exact exponential per step, leg speed = step mean (s6 spec 148 R-2)
valve.acts_on: speed reference u (valve flow / A_p) -> s_ref and the dashpot term

rod_release.rule: moving leg: s_ref += A_ann (p_hat_prev - p_hat) / k_h(s_ref), both directions (v5 spec 2.3, D-4); p_hat = p_r + Delta w (revision 4), p_r = rod-side law value before the pressure floor

pressure_law.rule: moving p_r: lag to p* capped by the valve flow; retract meter-in A_ann |u|, extend meter-out b_T A_h |u| sqrt((p_r - p_T) / dp_c); C_r = A_ann^2 (1/k_r + 1/k_h), B hose not included; M2 reads p_hat = p_r + Delta w, Delta = p_r0 - p_r,rel at the release, w = base release decay (revision 4); extension lock anchor p_r0 = max(min(p_tr, p_ext + max(p_tr - p*, 0)), p_floor), p_tr = moving rod pressure before the lock, p* = extension target; retract lock keeps p_ret (revision 5)

lock_closure.rule: zero command: u = 0 once the step mean spool speed <= overlap_ratio v_max; lock closing_delay_s later; dashpot by the law's lock state (v5 spec 2.5)

settle.rods_on_crawler_note: rod weights hang on the superstructure (legs in the air)

controller_meta.locked_pressure_warning_note: 10 Hz instantaneous samples: the 345 bar warning sees about 43 % of a heave transient and hardly any 102 Hz ringing; it is a quasi-static watch, not an overpressure protection (spec 99.3, U-R8-4)

s8_end.rule: C-S8-17 (spec rev. 43 213.8): D8 READY + 10 s, event + 45 s, HOLD READY + 120 s; upper bound duration + 60 s, else timeout

r8_series.guard_u: controller _state.guard_m_s (twist-vector share of the F_min guard, before the speed scaling / increment limit; NaN = no guard)
r8_series.imu_gyro_samples: C-S8-31: delivered gyro 10 ms partial means per period (periods x 10 x 3, rad/s, body axes, oldest first, the last ends at t); NaN = no IMU-rate samples
r8_series.probed_leg: (가): leg index 0..3 (FL, FR, RL, RR) the probe moves, -1 = none (not PROBE / round not started); C2Controller._probed_leg() after the control call (P-R8-11 rule)
r8_series.touched: C-S8-72: controller _state.touched per leg (1 latched / 0; NaN = not available), the TOUCH latch of spec rev. 67 345.2 T-2
r8_series.units: m/s, -, m/s^2, rad/s (imu_gyro_samples); t absolute s

s8_series.F_hat: delivered p_h A_p - p_r A_ann (sensor model applied, before the zero calibration)
s8_series.F_lower: reading lower bound = controller _state.last_forces.lower (calibrated, E-6 deduction, NO seal band; NaN = absent)
s8_series.F_lower_est: spec-199 lower bound F_hat_cal - F_band,i = controller _load_estimate_N(last_forces.lower) (C-S8-16 ①)

pad_record.rule: dynamics_model.md 5.22.3: loads from the force-law output (every-step minimum per 1 ms); NSC contact force as a 20 ms centred mean of the per-step 1 ms means (N, T, L, utilisation, R_world)
pad_record.sampling: time (crossing rule), contact mean step-length weighted
pad_record.air_rule: S8-A2: airborne (20 ms N <= 0) samples are not judged on the 1 ms rod-force minimum; F_cyl_mean_20ms and the 1 ms minimum are recorded
pad_record.s8_rule: C-S8-2: F_cyl = rod axial force (oil + seal friction, truth); F_pressure = F - f (two-sensor net force truth); head_pressure from F_pressure; stroke_true = piston s_p

piston_monitor.definition: s_p = s + F_acting / k_out (k_out = series(k_rod, k_frame[, k_concrete])), violation outside [lo - tol, hi + tol]

pressure_floor.rule: S8-A1: p_h = max(floor, (F_p + p_r A_ann) / A_p), p_r re-solved where it binds; floor = return 2 bar g moving, rod-side cavitation floor locked

runner.zero_order_hold: command applied at the control instant t_n drives step n+1 on
runner.record_u_cmd: command held during the step ending at the sample time
runner.record_instants: control instants only (no row at the start time)

valve.integration: exact exponential per step, leg speed = step mean (s6 spec 148 R-2)
valve.acts_on: speed reference u (valve flow / A_p) -> s_ref and the dashpot term

rod_release.rule: moving leg: s_ref += A_ann (p_hat_prev - p_hat) / k_h(s_ref), both directions (v5 spec 2.3, D-4); p_hat = p_r + Delta w (revision 4), p_r = rod-side law value before the pressure floor

pressure_law.rule: moving p_r: lag to p* capped by the valve flow; retract meter-in A_ann |u|, extend meter-out b_T A_h |u| sqrt((p_r - p_T) / dp_c); C_r = A_ann^2 (1/k_r + 1/k_h), B hose not included; M2 reads p_hat = p_r + Delta w, Delta = p_r0 - p_r,rel at the release, w = base release decay (revision 4); extension lock anchor p_r0 = max(min(p_tr, p_ext + max(p_tr - p*, 0)), p_floor), p_tr = moving rod pressure before the lock, p* = extension target; retract lock keeps p_ret (revision 5)

lock_closure.rule: zero command: u = 0 once the step mean spool speed <= overlap_ratio v_max; lock closing_delay_s later; dashpot by the law's lock state (v5 spec 2.5)

m2_law.rule: moving p_r: lag to p* capped by the valve flow; retract meter-in A_ann |u|, extend meter-out b_T A_h |u| sqrt((p_r - p_T) / dp_c); C_r = A_ann^2 (1/k_r + 1/k_h), B hose not included; M2 reads p_hat = p_r + Delta w, Delta = p_r0 - p_r,rel at the release, w = base release decay (revision 4); extension lock anchor p_r0 = max(min(p_tr, p_ext + max(p_tr - p*, 0)), p_floor), p_tr = moving rod pressure before the lock, p* = extension target; retract lock keeps p_ret (revision 5)

hydraulics_record.m2_releases_rule: v5 stage 3 R-1 (chrono/m2_release_log.py); shifts in s_ref sign; delta_ref = r0 / A_ann of the release hook

tension_truth.rule: plant p* > p_bB on an unlocked leg with valve > 0, per 1 ms; diagnostic; judged by extend_bound_check

extend_bound_check.rule: ③-on rows (tension_premise.md 5.4, 6.3), plant rod pressure p_tr at every controller read. ext_moving (judged): breach_reads = p_tr > p_hat + delta_m, the sum must be 0; margin_used_reads = p_tr > p_hat is a FLAG. ext_locked: judged by the VB T4h replay (t4h_replay with the ③-on setting, over_0p6kN == 0); here a cross-check FLAG against the monitor's model bound ④ (before the reading bound ⑤): locked_breach_reads = p_tr > ④, locked_breach_over_tol_reads = p_tr > ④ + 0.6 kN / A_ann (the T4h tolerance; > 0 is a FLAG, a VB T4h disagreement is a replay mismatch); locked_vs_extend_bound_reads = p_tr > p_hat + delta_m on locked legs, diagnostic only. 1 Pa rounding allowance; retracting legs apart (premise ④); null record = option off or no rod reading
